evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Fresh evaluator run reproduced the exact candidate fingerprint with zero canonical-validation, promoted-lineage, projection, provenance-graph, social-media-integrity, or public-safety violations.

Independent row recomputation produced 38 unique records: Posts=37, Replies=38, union=38, gap=0; 16 originals, 6 replies, 16 reposts; 22 @wowlist-authored records; and 35 external-link occurrences representing 35 distinct short URLs.

The 16-row incoming inventory independently produced 10 unique mission-relevant third-party accounts across four groups: seven DIY arts/music, one calendar-community, one neighborhood-civic, and one creative-technology peer. Nine have url-domain query provenance.

All six exclusions remain inspectable rather than becoming traction: two false positives, one unrelated handle reference, two context-limited greetings, and one project-contributor self-documentation record.

CLM-WOWLIST-SOCIAL-PRODUCT-SURFACE and its public projection characterize the results only as bounded public-use and distribution signals. Boundaries expressly reject adoption, attendance, reach, conversion, endorsement, event ownership, authorship, and causal-impact extrapolations.

Collective credit remains intact: the origin example names Richard and Jamie; community-created tutorial credit remains external; institutional posts are not attributed post-by-post to Jamie; Jamie is described as co-building and supporting the product rather than solely authoring the account or collective activity.

Fresh focused verification passed 26/26 knowledge-development tests and 10/10 citation tests; citation consistency, generated-registry redaction, knowledge-bank, and public-safety checks also exited successfully.
findings: The population and incoming-search metrics are reproducible denominators used to establish archival coverage and bounded observable behavior, not metric theater.
Direct action, collective product work, third-party behavior, institutional publishing, and downstream outcomes remain properly separated.
No adoption, attendance, reach, endorsement, authorship, causality, or impact inflation was found in the selected social claim.
evals.recommended_next_move: Preserve the row-derived assertions, six exclusions, collective-credit language, and explicit anti-causality boundaries whenever the WOW List projection changes.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: The production resolver successfully resolved wowlist/social-product-surface to the active approved CLM-WOWLIST-SOCIAL-PRODUCT-SURFACE projection and exactly 11 ordered public sources.

The resolved evidence includes the profile, full-population fixture, and nine concrete examples covering origin, community-created onboarding, product support, NYC DIY use, organizer use, peer attribution, meeting response, national event distribution, and popular.vote coordination.

The pinned fixture permalink uses commit cdf5d08798f1d5dbd516ac826e4537b07ab1bbf9. That commit object exists locally, is the current HEAD, and its fixture is byte-identical to the reviewed working fixture with SHA-256 d78f2cdb0258e84337888ece16b7088de7136807a5479cefc508e5a79da5fb02.

Curated reporting and resource sources are correctly assigned context roles with renderCitation=false; their records explicitly state that circulation does not establish WOW List coverage, partnership, fund administration, event ownership, attendance, adoption, or impact.

The case study supplies a coherent hiring argument: organizers needed decentralized event distribution; Jamie co-built and supported the product model, workflows, and public web system; followable keyword communities became usable publishing and discovery surfaces.

The direct examples strengthen that argument without overclaiming: Punks & Criminals documents organizer use, Music Hackathon supplies bounded Jamie attribution, the support reply shows a usable workflow, and the tutorial remains credited to its community creator.

Limits remain candid and legible: displayed-profile completeness is not complete deleted/private history; the incoming search is bounded; handle lineage remains open; interaction totals are excluded from reach or impact claims; and private user and organizer records remain protected.

Fresh focused tests confirmed public claim resolution, active-projection approval, source ordering, redaction, shared-account authorship boundaries, and full-population reconciliation with zero failures.
findings: A skeptical hiring reader can identify Jamie's action, the organizing purpose, the usable product result, the strongest direct sources, collective credit, and the archival limits without reconstructing the evidence graph.

The separate aggregate platform-scale statement is explicitly distinguished from the small social-account and incoming-search counts; the selected social evidence is not presented as an adoption or impact measure.
No material archival-integrity, citation-resolution, hiring-legibility, or institutional-publishing defect was observed.
evals.recommended_next_move: Retain the current selected projection and immutable fixture contract; keep context-only sources non-rendering and continue treating the unresolved handle lineage as open research.
